content: {"episode_id":"ep-05019","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I49.5 and I48.0. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), the note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management. We therefore request reconsideration of the authorization-based denial on the basis of the documented medical necessity for CPT 93229."}
